claim.evaluationRule: Evidence must be scoped, timestamped, attributable to a source, and must satisfy resultCriteria; absence is never interpreted as PASS.

evidence.decisionRule: PASS when Conditional Access requires MFA for every identity that administers Azure; FAIL when any administrator can manage Azure without MFA. TODO until the customer's documentary evidence is recorded.

objective: Defender for Servers plan read on each Arc machine (resource-level Pricings): tier, subplan, whether it inherits from the subscription, and enabled extensions.
assertion: FAIL if any machine has no Defender for Servers (Free); WARN if the machine plan differs from the subscription plan; PASS if all machines inherit the subscription plan.

claim.evaluationRule: Evidence must be scoped, timestamped, attributable to a source, and must satisfy resultCriteria; absence is never interpreted as PASS.

evidence.decisionRule: FAIL for an explicitly read effective Free plan and WARN for an explicit difference/override; retain PARTIAL evidence coverage when another machine is unread; PARTIAL when unread evidence is the only condition; PASS only when every effective resource plan and subscription comparison is conclusively read and consistent.

objective: Per machine with the SQL Server extension: LicenseType set on the extension (PAYG, Paid, LicenseOnly), use of a physical core license (pCore) and pCore licenses in scope, extension state, uploadStatus and time of the last usage upload (timestampUTC), machine status and operating system.
assertion: FAIL for a conclusive technical upload/connection/extension condition even when contractual entitlement coverage is PARTIAL; WARN for license metadata mismatches; N/A without the SQL extension.
